input_contract.validation: Check the exact frozen kotlin_loc_v3.py SHA-256 before loading its definitions, then reuse only validate_psi: exact source/PSI-source binding, explicitly allowed newline normalization, preorder parent/child inventory, partitioned ranges, complete leaf text and parser-error inventory. No reader prepare/run/preflight function is invoked.
input_contract.offset_conversion: Map complete UTF-16 character boundaries to Python Unicode character offsets for counting. Reject any native node boundary that splits a surrogate pair. Report normalized-source ownership coordinates explicitly.
input_contract.lexical_authority: Native PSI classes, node types, leaf spans, comment flags, whitespace flags and parent/child relationships. No Kotlin lexer or regular-expression language parser supplies ownership.

algorithm: Mask native comment nodes and literal data while preserving physical rows. Scalar string interpolation remains part of its literal expression; interpolation containing declarations, assignments or executable blocks receives a review diagnostic.
Use KtNamedFunction/KtClassBody/KtBlockExpression ownership and actual delimiter leaves for explicit headers and written closers. Expression-only functions receive no artificial header or close.

Use THEN/ELSE/BODY containers to distinguish statement-role if/for/while controls from scalar if expressions in initializers, operands, returns and expression functions. A final scalar if in a lambda supplies that lambda's value; preceding packed statements retain statement ownership.
Use KtWhenExpression braces and KtWhenEntry arrows for the written when header, individual branch headers, branch bodies and explicit closers, including expression-bodied functions.

Use KtLambdaExpression/KtFunctionLiteral and their native body ranges for lambda headers, each independent body statement and written close. Enclosing expression identity and disjoint successive headers handle callbacks inside arguments and chained calls.

A scalar continuation in the same enclosing expression adds no extra unit on an already-owned closer row. Independently wrapped continuation rows retain their physical unit. Inner callback body owners cannot be suppressed by an outer continuation.

Native KtProperty and KtDestructuringDeclaration nodes supply one declaration each; native assignment operators supply chained assignment expansion. Semicolon-packed native sibling statements remain separate. Literal/data wrapping remains physical.

KtParameter val/var nodes under a primary constructor are actual promoted fields; ordinary parameters remain structural. Headerless class rows expand to their independent fields without inventing a class header/close. With a written class body, the real class header and promoted fields each count, followed by the written close.

Reject unsupported executable owners, annotations without reviewed ownership, unowned bodies/braces, overlapping events, malformed PSI and non-scalar continuation work instead of supplying a qualified count.
